controlTower.intro: Design owner of the Agent Control Tower at OOCL — an agent platform built around a self-built agent runtime and agent core. Phase 1 delivers the full agent lifecycle (draft → active → retiring → retired) and an agent-generated dynamic dashboard (six element types, declarative queries, CSV/Excel/PDF export). The platform also includes an agent task queue for dispatching work across worker pods, a self-improvement pipeline, a knowledge base, dynamic workflow, an active notification system, human-in-the-loop control, live state tracking, versioned agent definitions, multi-replica routing, durable task/thread state, a self-built agent-pod registry, and a credential proxy. Agent definitions and skill changes are versioned; dispatch is attributable per worker pod.
controlTower.openSource: aria-conductor is the open-source simplification: 10 Java modules, human-in-the-loop gates, agent chains, a concurrency harness, and API E2E coverage.
controlTower.note: Validated on a 7-service Docker/Podman compose stack and across two replicas.

decomposer.body: Designed the job-decomposer library and heartbeat dispatch loop. A job is decomposed recursively into tasks and sub-tasks across N levels, then dispatched over asynchronous messaging. The heartbeat loop keeps dispatching, respects queue limits, and applies backpressure so large or continuously loaded jobs do not stall. Workers scale from configuration or available resources; job definitions persist with the decomposer and dispatch through its processing API.

observability.body: Production observability on Rancher-managed Kubernetes. Owns the metrics, logs, cloud monitoring, and release checks for a platform of 30+ services, and uses the same signals to verify rollouts and investigate incidents.

projects.name: aria-conductor
projects.description: Java 21 + React 19 control tower for agent chains. Fixed a concurrent-approval race that allowed double approvals; built the load and concurrency harness.
projects.cvDescription: Designed and built a multi-service control tower: 10 Java modules, React 19/TypeScript dashboard, Node/TypeScript MCP server, MariaDB/H2, Docker/Podman, and per-agent OpenSandbox containers; API E2E coverage. Implemented governance and operator workflows: human review gates, versioned knowledge, BA→Dev→QA agent chains, live run status, kanban, and activity timeline. Fixed a concurrent-approval race where two opposing approvals could both pass the same pending check and commit; replaced read-check-write with an atomic conditional update, so one request wins and the other is rejected with an HTTP 409 conflict. Fixed a 500 that rolled back the whole transaction under mixed load; built the load and concurrency E2E harness plus Playwright UI coverage. Added an OpenCode/Qoder ACP bridge.
